Great food - Great people
Mar 2024 • Couples
Found this place on TA and it was a 5 minute walk from our hotel. I ordered smoothies at lunch then came back for dinner; and returned the next night. This place has a two for one happy hour starting at 4pm and I took full advantage of that drinking amazing margarita’s both nights. The first night we both had chicken dishes that were delicious with fresh baked carrot cake for dessert. The next night we both had bangers & mash and the portions were a little small and we were hungry and it was delicious so we split a third one; and carrot cake for dessert again with coconut ice cream. The combination of the great food combined with the friendly talented staff made this place one of our favorites after a months travel in Vietnam. Highly recommend.
